steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap bright red into the bristles and lay pink in the sky with crisscross strokes
steps.rule: red is very strong so use a very small amount

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: load phthalo blue onto the same brush and lay blue around the pink
steps.rule: blue overpowers the pink quickly

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap blue projections into the sky for clouds

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend all of it very lightly

steps.subject: water
steps.action: tap phthalo blue onto the lower canvas to lay color for water

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: tap a little bright red low so the sky color reflects down
steps.load: small amount on the brush after washing
steps.where: lower area where light was left

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend where the blue and pink meet with crisscross strokes
steps.where: where the blue and pink meet
steps.new: stand back to judge the blend

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: mix midnight black, van dyke brown and alizarin crimson and pull flat
steps.load: pulled flat as far as possible

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: push the knife hard into the fabric to set a small peak
steps.rule: color stays in the canvas after scraping off the excess

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the big brush firmly down and blend the base out
steps.motion: firm pull, then blending the base
steps.rule: lays out highlights and shadows without commitment

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: mix dark sienna, bright red and yellow ochre into a marbled roll
steps.load: marbled and not over-mixed, cut across for a roll

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: let the knife float down the mountain with almost no pressure
steps.new: a touch of blue adds a shadow effect

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap the large brush at the base to create mist and push that part back
steps.rule: misty areas push part of the mountain back

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: slide another layer over the top starting from here
steps.where: over the top of the mountain
steps.rule: a layer right in front looks like the foreground

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: mist the area again with a soft misty tap

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add heavy dark shadows with the dark color
steps.load: dark color picked up on the brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add another peak in front and push the mountain back
steps.rule: a peak in front pushes the rest back

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap sap green and cad yellow up the side of the mountain
steps.rule: following the angles of the mountain matters most

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: add yellow ochre and indian yellow here and there
steps.load: picked up from the mountain color on the brush
steps.rule: mixing with the mountain color makes it flow together

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: add small touches of highlight
steps.load: highlight from the brush with a bit of dark
steps.rule: so they stand out
steps.new: pick up dark color now and then for contrast

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: make a darker green and let it go up the back side

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: tap black and phthalo blue on the brush and pull straight down
steps.load: a couple of colors tapped onto the brush
steps.rule: it is important to pull straight down

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: lightly go across the reflection
steps.rule: on wet canvas the paint moves
steps.new: gives the shimmer that looks like water

steps.subject: land
steps.action: load knife with van dyke brown and dark sienna and scrub in a little land
steps.load: roll cut off the knife, loaded the same each time
steps.where: out here, a little land area
steps.rule: the roll of paint is important when you practice

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: lay a straight water line under the land with liquid white

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a few ripple lines straight across
steps.rule: straight lines keep the water from running out of the painting

steps.subject: land
steps.action: mix van dyke brown and sap green into a dark color for the land mass

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: cover part of the land with another tree and leave some background showing
steps.rule: leaving some background showing creates distance

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull a clean 2in brush straight down and go across for reflections
steps.rule: reflections are not committed and can go anywhere

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: mix dark sienna and a little white and draw a tree trunk
steps.rule: as many or as few trunks as you like

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap color into the 1in brush and push it onto the leaves
steps.rule: shape and form matter, not random

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint leaves with the corner of the brush in yellow ochre, indian yellow, cad yellow and sap green
steps.load: varied yellows and green on the brush, a touch of red
steps.rule: a touch of red makes it sparkle

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: graze the large brush very lightly with a little downward pull
steps.new: just enough reflection to look nice

steps.subject: land
steps.action: scrub a brown and sienna mix in a land area underneath
steps.load: brown and sienna mixture on the brush

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: lay a little liquid white waterline underneath the land

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: put sticks and twigs in the dark areas between the bushes with a clean knife
steps.rule: helps create the illusion of depth

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap a big basic bush shape with sap green, midnight black, van dyke brown and alizarin crimson
steps.new: a big shape to build the painting from

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a trunk with a crook using the fan brush
steps.load: trunk mix still on the fan brush
steps.new: a trunk can have a crook

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a few limbs with thinned brown
steps.rule: if paint will not flow it is not thin enough

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap bright red, yellow ochre and cad yellow into leaves with a 1in brush
steps.rule: each leaf shape is different

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: drop small bushes in, farthest first, and add a little brown dirt
steps.load: brown for the dirt on the brush
steps.rule: farthest first creates the illusion of distance
